name: pad_synth
source: Rendered by faceauth/sim/sensor.py (SensorSim profiles gemini336-sim-v1, sensor_b) from CelebA align&cropped images (img_align_celeba, 202,599 JPEGs, from the HF mirror https://huggingface.co/datasets/student/celebA rev 2d31e6555722815c74ea7c845b07c1063dd705e9, Dataset.zip sha256 9464985fa6cfc84d0fe6b87a6e4f07a275c8bd3dfc8abd713218765de7d62306, extracted to data/tmp/pad/celeba_align) with the OFFICIAL annotations list_landmarks_align_celeba.txt + identity_CelebA.txt (data/datasets/celeba/raw/Anno); MediaPipe canonical face mesh (Apache-2.0) for live/mask geometry. Command: python scripts/train_pad.py gen --workers 40
license: Derived from CelebA: 'use is RESTRICTED to non-commercial research and educational purposes' (CelebA README; CUHK does not own the image copyrights). NON-COMMERCIAL / RESEARCH-ONLY. Simulator assets: MediaPipe canonical_face_model.obj, Apache-2.0.
notes: SYNTHETIC presentations: live subjects, print (flat/bent), replay (phone/tablet/monitor), mask_rigid, mask_silicone; 'inject_live' = perfect synthetic live frames used as the digital-injection attack in eval. Identity-disjoint train/val/test (CelebA identity labels, seed 7). Each frame file is msgpack {rgb: JPEG q95, depth: PNG uint16 mm, ir: PNG uint8, kps5, kind, meta} (packet.encode_frame wire format); per-file sha256 in manifest.jsonl. Not real sensor data: validates the pipeline only.

biwi.source: BIWI Kinect Head Pose RGB frames (data/datasets/biwi, research only); depth/IR rendered by SensorSim like the CelebA part, BIWI depth is not used
